description: This file defines a shell script function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that configures MAC addresses for various hardware board models during pre-initialization. It uses functions and commands from system configuration scripts to set network interface MAC addresses based on the board type.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: A function that sets MAC addresses for different boards based on their model names, using various methods to retrieve or calculate MAC addresses and applying them to network interfaces.
